- **Love in the City — Variant A:** I would ship A for its consistently substantial framing, saturated colours and close match to the references’ tabletop and object rendering.
- **Picture-Perfect Suburbia — Variant A:** I would ship A because its clear silhouettes and familiar camera angles produce the most consistent match across the ten cards.
- **Once Upon a Garden — Variant A:** I would ship A because most cards maintain simple focal shapes and controlled detail, with fewer conspicuously intricate compositions.
- **The Lost Island — Variant B:** I would ship B because its bold object silhouettes and simplified architecture give it the strongest overall consistency with the reference row.
